messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: sustained RPM spike for model family zephyr7b in us-west-2 – request queue > 1200 for 5m, avg tail latency > 2.1s. Relevant service: inference-gateway. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/1923456789
Priya (oncall): saw it. grabbing context. can someone pull per-model tpm/rpm state?
Omar: I have metrics – zephyr7b RPM surged to ~4500 (baseline ~800), TPM jumped accordingly. Backend GPU queues filling, OOMs on a few hosts. Likely a small set of customers hitting long streaming sessions.
Tara: any customer-facing errors yet? Support queue popping?
SupportBot: 5 open tickets referencing slow responses; 14 total recent 5xxs correlated with zephyr7b. Top customers: beta-invoice (id: cust-491), chatplay (cust-204).
Priya (oncall): priority: protect platform health. propose temporary per-model sculpt: reduce zephyr7b RPM to 400 and TPM to 60k, enable fallback routing to atlas-13b where feasible. Also enable prefix-KV cache bypass throttles. Anyone object?
Omar: agreed. lowering limits will shed a lot of traffic and reduce queue. atlas-13b has headroom. we should add a soft-failover config so we don't break customers who require zephyr7b determinism.
Alex: ready to apply. will run CLI change and patch routing rules. posting commands here.
Alex: ```
# reduce RPM/TPM for zephyr7b
redwoodctl quota set --model zephyr7b --rpm 400 --tpm 60000 --reason "emergency sculpt 1923456789"
# promote atlas-13b as fallback for zephyr family for 10m
redwoodctl routing update --policy fallback --from-family zephyr --to-model atlas-13b --duration 10m
```
Priya (oncall): run the rpm/tpm change first, wait 60s, then flip routing. keep logs open. I'll post when done.
Alex: executed quota set command at 1923456550. API returned 200.
Omar: seeing queue dropping already. zephyr7b queue depth down from 1200 -> 270 in 90s. tail latency down to 1.0s.
Tara: support notified top customers via PSIRT template. draft: "We're temporarily shaping traffic on zephyr7b to protect overall service; you may see reduced throughput or fallback to atlas-13b. We'll post updates." Sending now.
SupportBot: Notification sent to beta-invoice and chatplay. Ticket linked: TCK-8712, TCK-8713.
Priya (oncall): good. collect impact estimate: approx 7% of total requests rerouted, 1.8% experienced 429s due to new client-side throttles. Any internal error spike?
Omar: 5xxs down from 14 -> 3. CPU/GPU OOM alerts cleared.
Alex: routing change in place at 1923456640. configured soft-fallback (preserve model id in headers, allow atlas if zephyr doesn't respond within 800ms).
Priya (oncall): documenting mitigation steps in incident notes. we should annotate the console that zephyr family had emergency sculpt applied.
Alex: added console annotation + audit tag 'emergency-sculpt-1923456789'.
Dana (next-oncall): I'm taking HTO at 1923456800. what's the plan for rollforward/rollback?
Priya (oncall): handoff: continue monitoring for 30m windows. if queue stable and tail <1.2s for 15m, consider gradual restore: RPM -> 800 then TPM to baseline. rollback only after escalation check with SRE lead. I've captured commands and owners in the thread.
Dana (next-oncall): ack. will watch dashboards and alert on >10% regression.
Omar: one more thing — add short-lived circuit breaker for extremely long streaming sessions: drop sessions > 4k tokens with 429 to protect KV cache. I can open a PR for the runtime; but we can deploy a temporary rule at the gateway.
Alex: temporary gateway rule pushed: deny long-streams >4k tokens for zephyr7b (return 429 with Retriable header).
Tara: marking customers who saw 429s for proactive outreach after incident.
Priya (oncall): monitoring 10m now. if stable we'll start gradual restore at 1923457400. current status: mitigation in place, partial customer impact (degraded throughput / fallbacks), platform healthy.
SupportBot: customers updated. incident channel created: #incident-1923456789 (shared with PMs).
Priya (oncall): handing off to Dana for watch and rollback coordination. I'll remain on-call if needed. :thumbsup:
Dana (next-oncall): taking it. logging handoff. will update thread when I restore or escalate.
Priya (oncall): final note — action items: 1) postmortem with root-cause correlating the surge pattern, 2) review per-account rate limits and quota bump rules, 3) create automated sculpt playbook for zephyr family to avoid manual CLI steps next time.
Omar: noted, I'll start draft for playbook.
Alex: leaving logs & command history in /var/logs/incident-1923456789 for followup.
Dana (next-oncall): closing active mitigation log for now, continuing monitoring. will update in 15m. :white_check_mark:
